briefings.004: The Gigantors built a massive tower overnight. It now looms over the city like a fortress. The creatures inside have begun attacking nearby civilians. Assault the hive and eliminate the Gigantors.
briefings.022: The EDF is preparing an assault on the underground nests, but the battle above ground is tying up our forces. We need to cripple the Invaders long enough to strike. Scouts report that a large enemy fleet will spend the night in a quiet coastal inlet. Give them a brutal goodnight.
briefings.026: The EDF is launching an all-out attack on the underground nests. Destroy the spawning pits before the Gigantors overrun humanity. Expect fierce resistance as soon as you enter the tunnel. Wipe out the defenders and clear a path for the allied units behind you.
briefings.036: This is a cleanup operation. Eliminate all the giant creatures that fled into the city. This is the final battle for the EDF.
briefings.070: Attacks are intensifying worldwide, and few human forces remain. The Invaders have sent an army of colossal creatures against the resistance in Japan. Creatures as long as 40 meters have entered the city.
briefings.073: The Genocide Cannon aboard the floating city has razed cities around the globe. Only Japan remains. The Invaders are assembling their entire force here. Strike and inflict as much damage as you can. The odds are hopeless. Participation is voluntary.
briefings.075: We destroyed the main Invader force, but units from around the world are arriving. Their entire army surrounds us. Escape is unlikely. Civilization has fallen. The EDF may have nothing left to defend, but we will fight to the end.
briefings.078: The floating city has appeared overhead to crush the remaining resistance. We have nowhere left to retreat. The Invaders never expected us to survive this long. The EDF will fight one last battle.

weapons.ENERGY_LASERRAPIER01: Developed after the first Invader War, this plasma arc gun cuts through targets at point-blank range. Its short reach makes it risky to use, but its sustained fire is devastating up close.
weapons.ROCKETLAUNCHER01: A versatile launcher for long-range attacks. Its rockets explode on impact and damage nearby enemies. Keep your distance so you stay clear of the blast.
